verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and SDK docs with static code snippets, but nothing documents an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it-in-the-docs examples. A raw spec and static snippets are building blocks, not the capability itself, and the web terminal is an adjacent sandbox feature rather than an API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
